messages:
ravi: quick sync: need to finalize token model and revocation semantics for the authn/authz refactor. main constraints: low-latency edge checks, auditable mappings, and minimal client changes.
claire: agree. two high-level options: JWT-style with embedded claims or opaque tokens with introspection. pros/cons?
dmitri: opaque + introspect gives better control for revocation but costs a call. JWT is fast but stale on role changes.
ravi: leaning opaque with a small fast-path: include a compact signed claim_snapshot_id and claim_version in token metadata so edge can accept if local version matches. falls back to introspect if mismatch.
claire: spelling oops.
claire: that seems reasonable. What about pinned long-lived creds for daemons? ops want stable creds for long jobs.
dmitri: pinned leases allowed but require attestation from orchestration + UI approval. cap max pin TTL (72h) and require re-attestation for extension.
ravi: revocation model: two modes: (1) policy-change (role edited) -> claim_version bump -> eventual expiry (<=5m); (2) emergency revoke -> push hard-revoke via streaming RPC to edge nodes (aim <10s).
jena: edges need a lightweight revocation bloom or id-set to check token ids. streaming RPC + local bloom updates sounds good. include fallback polling.
ravi: cross-project calls: token carries origin_project and actor_id. Receiver must consult a trust-mapping table; if mapping exists map to local actor, else deny or map to least-privileged. mapping changes must be audited and two-step approved.
claire: SDK changes: add mint(), refresh(), introspect helpers and transparent caching to keep client surface stable. We should support legacy header exchange behind opt-in flag.
dmitri: security note: automatic legacy-exchange must be opt-in and rate-limited. record exchanged=true in broker logs.
jena: rollout: feature-flag broker, SDK opt-in, canary subset of services, perf bench (p50/p95 mint impact), then enable exchange for infra after audit. deprecate long-lived keys after 6 months.
ops-bot: Reminder  schedule security review and file RFC link.
audit-bot: Audit requirement: all cross-project mapping edits and pin approvals must be immutable-audit logged.
ravi: I'll draft RFC with these decisions and attach a short incident playbook for broker failures. will post link by EOD.
